justification: Inspected `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/encode/Formatter.java`, `ContactEncoder.java`, `VCardContactEncoder.java`, `VCardFieldFormatter.java`, `VCardTelDisplayFormatter.java`, and `MECARDContactEncoder.java`. `Formatter` is only a 1-method package-private strategy interface (`format(CharSequence, int)`), with no fields or bundled responsibilities; the actual formatting behavior is split into separate concrete classes/inner classes for vCard and MECARD. That structure shows decomposition rather than insufficient modularization.
